recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-13364 unless PA reopens the later CodeableReference or cardinality decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-13364 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for STU3 Encounter. It asked to remove the misleading PV1-10 mapping from Encounter.serviceProvider and add Encounter.serviceType 0..* with an example ServiceType binding and a PV1-10 mapping.
initial_application: Historical commit f4b6c9c7d8c20db1a1b04162e1f13143723c8935 explicitly included GF#13364 and added Encounter.serviceType to the Encounter spreadsheet source with CodeableConcept, the broad service categorization definition, and v2 Mapping = PV1-10. The 2021 source conversion commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried that element and mapping into source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml.
additional_context: Later Published PA decisions changed the same element without reversing the PV1-10 mapping: FHIR-22687 changed Encounter.serviceType to CodeableReference(HealthcareService), and FHIR-25794 changed Encounter.serviceType cardinality to 0..*. Focused Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The active source/fhir.ini resource list includes Encounter, and source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml defines Encounter.serviceType as 0..* CodeableReference(HealthcareService), binds it by example to ValueSet/service-type, and maps it to PV1-10. Encounter.serviceProvider maps to PL.6 and PL.1, not PV1-10.
